1.consolidated_definition: Planta herbácea que crece en forma de enredadera, de hojas ovaladas, flores rojas en ramilletes de cinco a seis, y fruto en cápsula. Convolvulaceae; Quamoclit quamoclit.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Perennial herbaceous plant that grows in the form of a climber, with oval-shaped leaves, red flowers in clusters of five to six, and fruit in a capsule. Convolvulaceae; Quamoclit quamoclit.
